8095f2af8af6931d.description: About IOTA GROUP and Our Client IOTA GROUP is seeking an Electrical / Instrumentation & Telecom Supervisor for a contract position in Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia. 80b1d1b04afdc813.description: About Petromin Corporation Petromin Corporation is seeking a General Manager Internal Audit to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for providing independent and objective assurance and advisory functions to the Board and executive management. Role Purpose and Context The General Manager Internal Audit leads the function responsible for delivering risk-based assurance on the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control. This position ensures the independence and objectivity of Internal Audit, promotes conformance with the Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS 2024), and strengthens the control environment to support strategic objectives, governance maturity, and capital-markets readiness where applicable. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain a risk-based annual and multi-year audit plan aligned with the enterprise risk profile and strategy, securing Audit Committee approval and ensuring adequate resourcing. Direct the execution of financial, operational, compliance, IT, and governance audits, ensuring engagements are evidence-based, well-supervised, and lead to sound conclusions. Protect the independence of the function and the objectivity of auditors, escalating any impairment to the Audit Committee and ensuring management owns remediation of findings. Report significant findings, root causes, and agreed management actions to the Audit Committee, assessing management responses and tracking timely closure of audit observations. Administer the Audit Committee, including agendas, meeting packs, minutes, and the annual meeting calendar, ensuring alignment with corporate governance regulations. Establish and maintain the Quality Assurance & Improvement Program (QAIP), including internal assessments and periodic External Quality Assessment (EQA), driving GIAS 2024 conformance. Own and periodically refresh the Internal Audit Charter, ensuring conformance with GIAS, the Code of Ethics, and applicable regulatory expectations. Provide consulting and advisory input on the design of controls and governance without assuming management responsibility or impairing future independence. Coordinate with external auditors, regulators, and the second line to optimize assurance coverage and avoid duplication. Recruit, develop, and retain audit talent, managing performance and embedding continuous professional development and relevant certification. Advance the use of data analytics and audit/GRC tooling to improve coverage, efficiency, and insight. Performance Indicators Approved audit plan completion rate. Percentage of audit observations closed within agreed timelines, validated by Internal Audit. QAIP maturity and External Quality Assessment (EQA) conformance rating. Audit Committee and executive stakeholder satisfaction. Quality of engagement files (supervisory review, evidence, rating consistency). Team certification, capability, and retention metrics. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic environment focused on strengthening governance and risk management frameworks.

8008863dbe5e1bb6.description: Job Summary International Maritime Industries is seeking a Commissioning Superintendent, Electrical for a full-time position. This role involves overseeing the comprehensive planning, coordination, execution, testing, energization, integration, and handover of electrical pre-commissioning and commissioning activities for new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. The primary objective is to ensure safe and compliant system operation, operational readiness, successful project delivery, and client acceptance, adhering to project specifications, class requirements, and offshore regulatory standards. Key Responsibilities Lead the development of commissioning procedures, test packs, inspection and test records (ITRs), commissioning schedules, and system boundaries. Coordinate design reviews, risk assessments, factory acceptance tests, and readiness reviews to ensure commissioning preparedness and execution efficiency. Direct the commissioning, testing, energization, and performance verification of generators, alternators, switchboards, MCCs, power distribution systems, protection relays, and Power Management Systems (PMS). Manage the commissioning and functional testing of AC/DC variable frequency drives, drilling machinery, auxiliary drives, interlocks, and control logic interfaces. Oversee the commissioning and integration of jacking, skidding, ballast, bilge, navigation, emergency, and associated marine electrical systems. Lead cause-and-effect testing, functional verification, and integration of emergency shutdown (ESD), fire and gas (F&G), BOP control, UPS, battery backup, and emergency power systems. Oversee the inspection, validation, and certification compliance of hazardous area electrical installations and Ex-proof equipment in accordance with IECEx, ATEX, and applicable industry standards. Direct electrical testing, continuity verification, insulation resistance testing, loop checking, system energization, fault diagnosis, and corrective actions. Manage commissioning interfaces with engineering, construction, instrumentation, automation, mechanical disciplines, OEM vendors, class authorities, and client representatives. Champion compliance with LOTO, PTW, JSA, SIMOPS, project QHSE requirements, and applicable ABS, DNV, API, IEC, IEEE, IMO, and shipyard standards. Oversee commissioning dossiers, test records, punch-list management, readiness reviews, client acceptance activities, and system turnover packages. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 12–15 years of experience in electrical commissioning on new-build offshore rigs, specifically jack-up rigs.

802fdd956e074fbe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مايكرولاند عن فني نظم حاسب آلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير الدعم لأنظمة تكنولوجيا المعلومات لضمان كفاءة عمل جميع الأجهزة والشبكات، مما يسهم في تحقيق الأهداف التجارية للمؤسسة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية توفير الدعم لأنظمة تكنولوجيا المعلومات لضمان عمل أجهزة الكمبيوتر والشبكات بكفاءة عالية. تجميع وتثبيت أجهزة كمبيوتر سطح المكتب للعملاء ومساعدة المستخدمين النهائيين في تأمين أجهزتهم. تقديم الدعم المادي لفرق دعم تكنولوجيا المعلومات في أنشطة الصيانة الدورية للأجهزة والبرامج واستفسارات الشبكة. دعم الأنشطة الفنية اليومية لأجهزة الكمبيوتر وجميع أجهزة نقطة النهاية الأخرى. تحديث تذاكر الدعم بالتقدم المحرز في حل المشكلات. إعداد واختبار الأجهزة الطرفية لأجهزة الكمبيوتر المكتبية. إجراء تغييرات النظام بما يتوافق مع سياسات المنظمة. تنفيذ استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها عن بعد لأجهزة الكمبيوتر للمستخدمين النهائيين، بالإضافة إلى صيانة تذاكر التوثيق. الحفاظ على الوثائق الفنية بالتعاون مع الأقسام الوظيفية الأخرى. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال دعم نظم الحاسب الآلي أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لأنظمة تكنولوجيا المعلومات، بما في ذلك الأجهزة والشبكات والبرامج. القدرة على تجميع وتثبيت أجهزة الكمبيوتر وإعداد الأجهزة الطرفية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها. القدرة على تقديم الدعم الفني عن بعد. مهارات تواصل قوية لدعم المستخدمين النهائيين والتعاون مع الفرق الداخلية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المنظمة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق دعم تكنولوجيا المعلومات، ويكون مسؤولاً عن تقديم الدعم الميداني والتقني. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مايكرولاند.

Resolve first-level technical issues related to software, hardware, and network systems to restore user productivity within defined Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR). Utilize the knowledge base and troubleshooting tools to provide effective and consistent first-line support to end users. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to second-line support teams to ensure timely resolution and minimal business disruption. Monitor open service tickets to ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and prompt follow-up with users. Communicate with end users regarding incident progress, resolutions, and preventive recommendations to enhance user satisfaction and trust in IT support services. Document recurring issues and solutions in the knowledge base to support continuous improvement and faster future resolutions. Coordinate with infrastructure and application teams to identify root causes and recommend corrective or preventive measures. Assist in the deployment and configuration of end-user devices and software to ensure proper functionality and standardization across the organization. Support IT service improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and service quality within the Infrastructure & Operations unit. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should possess 1-2 years of relevant experience. The role requires a foundational understanding of IT support principles and a commitment to customer service. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on providing essential IT support to the company's Headquarters and Distribution Center.

80b0e5b676776574.description: About the Role Cooper Fitch is supporting a confidential search for a Head of Investment & Portfolio Management. 8057a8cbee91e59b.description: About the Role Nestlé Saudi Arabia LLC is seeking a Senior Brand Manager for Coffee to lead the Coffee business across Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Bahrain. This full-time role, based in Makkah (Jeddah, Makkah), covers the entire Coffee portfolio, including Pure Soluble, Mixes, Portioned Coffee, and Ready-to-Drink (RTD) products across all Coffee brands. The Senior Brand Manager will define and execute the Cluster Coffee strategy, adapting MENA brand strategies into relevant local plans, and identifying local growth opportunities in portfolio, innovation, communication, and consumer activation. This position involves leading a team of two and collaborating with regional and local cross-functional teams to enhance consumer penetration, particularly among youth, strengthen brand relevance, and sustain market share growth. The role manages the Coffee PFME budget, prioritizing investments and tracking brand, consumer, and commercial performance to implement corrective actions as needed. Key Responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of Coffee consumers, shoppers, consumption occasions, channels, and competitive dynamics across Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Bahrain, ensuring strategies reflect market differences. Lead annual Coffee business and brand plans for the Cluster, aligning with MENA strategy and Integrated Commercial Planning processes. Define strategic priorities by brand, segment, market, consumer, occasion, and channel. Partner with Sales, Commercial Development, Finance, and Demand & Supply Planning to align brand plans and activity calendars with commercial execution. Lead the local implementation of the Coffee portfolio strategy across various formats and consumption occasions. Contribute to pricing and pack-price architecture recommendations and collaborate on promotional plans. Translate regional brand strategies into locally relevant engagement plans, localizing and amplifying regional campaigns. Lead locally created campaigns and activations from insight to post-campaign evaluation, working with agency partners. Identify local innovation and renovation opportunities based on consumer needs and portfolio gaps. Act as the Marketing lead for local I2L projects, contributing to business cases and launch strategies. Manage the Coffee PFME budget for the Cluster, developing annual recommendations and maintaining strong budget control. Lead, coach, and develop the Coffee Marketing team, fostering a high-performance, consumer-centric culture. Lead cross-functional teams to deliver the Coffee agenda and build strong relationships with MENA Category teams. Ensure flawless execution of Coffee plans across markets, channels, and consumer touchpoints, adhering to Nestlé policies and local regulations. Qualifications and Experience Experience: Strong and progressive marketing experience within FMCG or another consumer-led industry, with a proven track record of delivering brand and business growth. Previous experience leading and developing people is required. Brand Building: Proven experience in core brand building, consumer communication, portfolio management, and business planning. Consumer Focus: Strong consumer and shopper orientation, with the ability to translate consumer insights into distinctive growth strategies and execution. Portfolio Management: Experience managing multiple brands, segments, or a complex portfolio is highly valued; beverage experience is preferred. Innovation: Proven experience developing locally relevant consumer initiatives within regional or global brand frameworks, and leading product launches, innovation, or complex renovation projects with cross-functional teams. Financial Acumen: Good understanding of key brand and product P&L drivers, ability to connect marketing choices to business outcomes, and demonstrated experience managing significant marketing budgets. Digital Marketing: Strong understanding of media, digital marketing, social media, influencer marketing, content, and eCommerce. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical capabilities combined with sound commercial judgment and the ability to translate data into clear actions. Leadership: Excellent leadership, project management, and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams within a matrix organization. Communication: Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with high learning agility, curiosity, and bias for action. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covering operations across Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Bahrain. The role involves leading a team of two and working within a matrix organization, collaborating with various cross-functional teams and regional stakeholders.

80b65944b81032e2.company_name: مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات
80b65944b81032e2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نبيل عبدالله ابونهيه وشريكه عن فني صيانة مباني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان صيانة المباني بفعالية، من خلال دراسة خطط الصيانة وتحديد العيوب الفنية ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية. تحديد العيوب الفنية في المباني ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة. تجهيز قائمة بالأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز مهام الصيانة. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة لضمان سيرها وفق الخطط. رفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة وحالتها. كيل الأعمال المنجزة لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق خطط الصيانة الفنية. مهارات جيدة في تحديد المشكلات الفنية واقتراح الحلول. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة المباني بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الشركة في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية، حيث يساهم في الحفاظ على جودة وكفاءة مرافق الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

80e7a2e21111bc66.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث واحة المعرفة عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان نقل الركاب بأمان وفعالية، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور ومعايير السلامة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب مع الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة، والإبلاغ الفوري عن أي تأخير طارئ. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على السيارة للتحقق من سلامتها وأدائها، ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تظهر. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب فحصاً من قبل الخبراء. التقيد التام بالأدلة الإجرائية، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال قيادة السيارات. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء فحوصات أساسية للسيارة وتحديد المشكلات البسيطة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادة آمنة ومسؤولة. الالتزام بالمواعيد والدقة في الأداء. القدرة على التعامل مع المواقف الطارئة بفعالية. تفاصيل العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في حائل. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى واحة المعرفة كسائق سيارة خاص، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

80718f57270662fc.description: About the Appian Delivery Team at Halian Halian is seeking to build an Appian Delivery Team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time team will be responsible for the end-to-end design, development, integration, and quality assurance of Appian applications for a banking client. The roles within the team require professionals with 5-10 years of experience in their respective Appian specializations. Key Roles and Responsibilities Overview The Appian Delivery Team encompasses several specialized roles, each contributing to the robust implementation and support of Appian solutions. These roles include an Appian Technical Lead / Solution Architect, Senior Appian Developer – Process & Workflow, Appian Developer – UI & Data Fabric, Appian Integration Developer, and an Appian QA & Automation Engineer. Each role is critical for delivering scalable, secure, and efficient Appian applications that meet enterprise standards and regulatory obligations. Appian Technical Leadership and Solution Architecture Own the end-to-end solution design and technical delivery of Appian applications. Act as the design authority for the Appian platform, ensuring solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, operational resilience, and regulatory standards. Translate business requirements into scalable Appian solution architectures, including process design, security models, integration patterns, and data structures. Define development standards, governance frameworks, reusable components, and coding best practices. Lead technical estimations, sprint planning, architecture reviews, and release planning activities. Own non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, security, and auditability. Conduct code reviews, health checks, and production readiness assessments. Mentor development teams and drive adoption of new Appian capabilities. Appian Development and Integration Responsibilities Design and develop complex process models, case management workflows, and business rules. Implement enterprise-scale case management capabilities and configure decision tables and expression rules. Develop responsive Appian SAIL interfaces, portals, and reusable UI components, supporting bilingual Arabic and English user experiences. Design and configure Data Fabric record types, relationships, security models, and record actions. Develop Appian Connected Systems, Integration Objects, and Web APIs to connect with enterprise applications and third-party services. Design secure authentication and authorization models, including OAuth2, SAML, and API security controls. Implement resilient integration patterns and build batch processing solutions. Support implementation of Appian AI capabilities, including document extraction and intelligent automation features. Quality Assurance and Automation Define and execute testing strategies covering functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing. Develop and maintain automated test frameworks for Appian applications. Build API and integration testing capabilities using modern automation tools. Embed testing processes within CI/CD pipelines and release management practices. Conduct load, performance, and stress testing for critical workflows. Validate role-based security, segregation of duties controls, and audit logging. Manage test data, test environments, and production-like datasets. Lead defect management activities and produce quality metrics and reporting. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for these roles should possess 7-10 years of relevant experience in Appian development, architecture, integration, or quality assurance. Specific experience with Appian capabilities such as Data Fabric, Process HQ, AI Skills, and Appian RPA is beneficial. The ability to work collaboratively within a team environment and align with enterprise standards is essential.

802f003fd92a9997.description: Senior Planning Engineer at DAR Engineering DAR Engineering, a leading design and engineering consulting organization in Saudi Arabia, is seeking an experienced Senior Planning Engineer. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and is crucial for leading the planning and scheduling of design projects within the company's Planning & Project Controls (PMO) Department. Role Purpose and Context The Senior Planning Engineer will be responsible for developing and maintaining integrated design programs, tracking progress across various design disciplines, and providing project and PMO leadership with timely visibility into project status. The role requires a combination of design engineering background and strong planning expertise, with an understanding of how design deliverables, disciplines, and client reviews interact to create realistic and well-controlled schedules. The position reports directly to the Planning Manager. Key Responsibilities Develop, baseline, and maintain integrated design schedules for engineering and design projects, covering all disciplines from concept through detailed design and tender documentation. Break down design scope into work packages, deliverables, and milestones, linking them to a clear work breakdown structure. Plan and forecast resource and man-hour requirements with discipline leads, and track resource loading against the program. Monitor actual progress against the baseline, analyze variances and the critical path, and recommend recovery actions for delays. Coordinate with project managers, design discipline leads, sub-consultants, and clients to collect progress inputs and align interdependencies, including review and approval periods. Assess the schedule impact of design changes, client instructions, and scope variations, and support the preparation of related time-impact records. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, dashboards, and presentations for project teams, management, and clients. Provide early warning of schedule risks and delays to project managers and the PMO. Support the PMO in standardizing planning procedures, templates, and reporting across engineering and design projects, and contribute to portfolio-level reporting. Maintain the integrity of schedule data, including baselines, updates, and archived versions. Mentor junior planners and share good planning practices across the team. Capture lessons learned and contribute to the continuous improvement of planning and scheduling processes. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in planning and scheduling, preferably within a design engineering environment. Demonstrated expertise in developing and maintaining integrated design schedules. Strong understanding of design deliverables, discipline interactions, and client review processes. Proficiency in relevant planning and scheduling software. Ability to analyze variances, critical paths, and recommend recovery actions. Excellent communication and coordination skills for interacting with project teams, clients, and sub-consultants. Work Environment and Benefits This is an on-site, full-time position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. DAR Engineering offers a collaborative and supportive environment within a leading multidisciplinary consultancy. The compensation package includes a competitive salary and benefits, such as housing and transportation, along with comprehensive healthcare coverage and wellness support. The company fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace that values innovation and teamwork. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are invited to submit their application online. Riyadh-based candidates are preferred, but relocation support is available for suitable talent. The application deadline is 20 November 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by the Talent Acquisition team for an interview process, which typically includes two stages, often beginning virtually and concluding with an in-person interview at the office.

805002416131881c.description: About the Role LUMA Energy is seeking a CX Advisor Regional to join their team in Neom, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for an individual with 1-3 years of experience. The CX Advisor serves as the primary point of contact for customers, managing a variety of inquiries to ensure accurate information delivery and a positive customer experience. Key Responsibilities Provide assistance to internal and external customers by directing, gathering, and delivering information for issue resolution, addressing concerns and complaints related to billing, claims, or retailer inquiries. Ensure accurate application of Best Practices, Financial Practices, Tariffs, and Terms and Conditions to maintain compliance and operational consistency. Complete service agreements and other necessary documents, obtaining customer signatures as required for finalized and validated agreements. Initiate customer accounts with attention to detail and accuracy, prepare invoices, and collect customer payments to ensure accurate account setup and timely payment collection. Issue deposit certificates, accept money from deposits or bill payments, balance daily receipts, deliver funds to the appropriate employee or supervisor, and obtain proof of delivery for secure financial transactions. Process payments via all methods received in regional offices and determine the applicable rate according to the requested service for accurate payment processing. Prepare detailed account statements, invoices, apply deposits, adjust accounts, and process charges and miscellaneous credits manually or through automated systems for precise financial records. Prepare, record, and send documents to necessary inter-departments for Customer Excellence delivery, facilitating efficient interdepartmental communication. Receive reports about irregularities in reading, billing, maintenance, and other related duties, investigate, correct, and process irregularities through the instant information system for timely issue resolution. Follow established company policies, procedures, and standards to ensure full compliance with applicable laws and industry regulations. Participate in storm restoration tasks and assigned drills to contribute to the safe and reliable recovery of services. Perform additional tasks aligned with role expectations and qualifications to support team goals and operational flexibility. Required Experience 1-3 years of relevant experience. Physical Demands Constantly in a stationary position. Seldom required to push, pull, reach, kneel, grab, or bend. Ability to lift/carry up to 0-15 LBS. Requires 20/20 corrected vision. Ability to receive detailed information if spoken to. Working Conditions Never exposed to wet or humid conditions, moving mechanical parts, heavy machinery, high places, fumes, airborne particles, outdoor weather, or electricity. Seldom exposed to loud noise conditions. Equal Employment Opportunity LUMA Energy is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, military status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal or local laws.

80d649075cae56f5.description: About the Role flyadeal is seeking a Cabin Crew member to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring the safety, security, and comfort of guests while delivering a professional onboard experience. The position is suitable for individuals with 2-5 years of experience who thrive in fast-paced environments and maintain composure under pressure. Role Overview As a Cabin Crew Member, you will be responsible for upholding the highest safety standards, providing customer service, and contributing to efficient flight operations. This role requires individuals who enjoy working with people and can maintain a professional appearance and attitude across various operational cities including Jeddah, Riyadh, Dammam, and Medina. Key Responsibilities Ensure the safety and security of passengers and fellow crew members throughout all phases of flight. Deliver customer service while maintaining flyadeal's service standards. Welcome and assist guests during boarding and disembarkation. Conduct safety demonstrations and pre-flight safety checks. Respond professionally and efficiently to passenger enquiries and onboard situations. Prepare, serve, and sell food, beverages, and onboard retail products. Support aircraft turnaround activities, including cabin preparation and restocking. Work collaboratively with fellow Cabin Crew and Flight Deck members to ensure smooth operations. Maintain compliance with flyadeal policies, aviation regulations, and safety procedures. Participate in recurrent training and continuous professional development. Required Experience and Attributes Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. Successful applicants will demonstrate a range of personal attributes essential for this role: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Outstanding customer service mindset. Professional appearance and grooming. Ability to remain calm under pressure. Strong teamwork and collaboration. High level of responsibility and safety awareness. Adaptability and willingness to learn. Positive attitude and commitment to delivering service. The role requires working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as part of a dedicated Cabin Crew team, ensuring consistent service and safety standards across all flights.

803a4e84285884b8.description: About 10 Design 10 Design, part of the Egis Group, is an international architecture and master planning practice established in 2010. With offices in Hong Kong, Shanghai, Edinburgh, Dubai, Miami, London, Shenzhen, Singapore, and San Francisco, the practice has received over 80 international awards. Its diverse team of 380 architects and designers from 35 nationalities has delivered projects in 60 cities across Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and the Americas. 10 Design focuses on innovative design solutions for multicultural projects, encompassing transport-oriented developments, mixed-use, retail, hospitality, residential, research and science, and civic and cultural projects. Egis, the parent company, is a global leader in consulting, construction engineering, and mobility services, known for excellence and sustainability. Together, 10 Design and Egis offer integrated building engineering services and architectural design. The Role of Senior Utilities Engineer (Design) 10 Design is seeking a Senior Utilities Engineer (Design) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the design and development of comprehensive utilities systems for complex projects. The successful candidate will ensure technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and efficient project delivery, working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to translate project requirements into detailed technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and precision. Key Responsibilities Design and develop utilities infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and plumbing components. Prepare detailed technical drawings, specifications, and design documentation using industry-standard software and tools. Conduct feasibility studies, load calculations, and cost-benefit analyses for utilities systems. Coordinate with project managers, architects, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure design alignment and project objectives. Ensure all designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements in Saudi Arabia and internationally. Manage design revisions, updates, and documentation control throughout the project lifecycle. Perform quality assurance reviews and validation of design deliverables. Participate in project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation activities. Analyze system performance and recommend optimization strategies for efficiency and sustainability. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the continuous improvement of design processes. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in utilities design. The position requires a strong understanding of utilities infrastructure systems and the ability to apply industry standards and regulatory compliance. Work Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

804e51a912e631ab.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع العارض الطبي في الرياض عن طبيب جراح عيون للانضمام إلى فريقه. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إجراء الفحوصات البصرية وتشخيص أمراض العيون وإصاباتها، بالإضافة إلى إجراء العمليات الجراحية اللازمة ومتابعة المرضى في جميع مراحل العلاج. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص البصري الشامل للمرضى وفحص العين، وتشخيص طبيعة الإصابات والأمراض وأسبابها بناءً على الفحوصات ونتائج الاختبارات. تقديم الرعاية الطبية المتخصصة لعلاج أو الوقاية من إصابات وأمراض واضطرابات العيون، مثل التنكس البقعي والجلوكوما والكتاراكت. وصف النظارات والعدسات اللاصقة لتحسين مشكلات الإبصار لدى المرضى. إجراء العمليات الجراحية للعيون، بما في ذلك إزالة الكتاراكت وزرع القرنية واستئصال الأورام أو النتوءات من العصب البصري. مراقبة الحالة الصحية للمرضى وتقييم استجابتهم للعلاج، وإعادة تقييم الخطط العلاجية حسب الضرورة. تقديم الرعاية للمريض قبل وبعد العملية الجراحية لضمان أفضل النتائج. توثيق الإجراءات الطبية أثناء العملية الجراحية، وخطة المعالجة، والبيانات المرضية والعلاجية للمريض وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال طب وجراحة العيون. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من أمراض وإصابات العيون. مهارات جراحية ممتازة في إجراء عمليات العيون المختلفة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى والزملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق طبي متعدد التخصصات. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التشخيص والعلاج. الالتزام بالمعايير الطبية والأخلاقية المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب جراح العيون ضمن فريق مجمع العارض الطبي في الرياض، في بيئة عمل داعمة ومجهزة بأحدث التقنيات لتقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مجمع العارض الطبي، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور والراتب.

80f8aaffd5c91347.job_title: Commis Staff Canteen Jumeirah Jabal Omar Hotel
80f8aaffd5c91347.description: About Jumeirah Hotels and Resorts Jumeirah, a member of Dubai Holding, is a global luxury hospitality company operating a portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. Established in 1999 with the opening of Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, the brand is recognized for its beachfront resorts, city hotels, and residences. Jumeirah is known for its service and for crafting distinctive experiences for guests. About Jumeirah Jabal Omar Hotel Jumeirah Jabal Omar Makkah is located near Masjid Al Haram in the Holy City. The hotel comprises four towers and includes various dining venues, retail outlets, a gym, an executive lounge, and meeting spaces. It offers views of the Grand Mosque and a culinary selection featuring Mediterranean, Persian, Middle Eastern, and Southeast Asian cuisines. About the Role Jumeirah Jabal Omar Hotel is seeking a Commis 1 for the Staff Canteen. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience in a similar role. The Commis 1 will be responsible for preparing and cooking meals for the staff canteen, ensuring adherence to recipes and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Receive and accurately execute orders from the Chef de Partie, following instructions and recommendations to meet daily requirements. Gather, measure, mix, and prepare meal ingredients, sauces, and seasonings according to established recipes and specifications. Wash, peel, and chop vegetables, fruits, and meats with precision, demonstrating proficiency in cutting, seasoning, and marinating as needed. Perform cooking techniques and plating according to specifications provided by the Demi Chef or Chef de Partie, ensuring high standards of dish preparation. Document inventory of kitchen supplies, monitor stock levels, and notify supervisors of low stock to maintain sufficient supplies. Operate kitchen equipment such as braising pans, ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers effectively, ensuring correct temperature settings for cooking and baking. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a culinary role, preferably within a hotel or staff canteen environment. Ability to follow instructions and recipes accurately. 808a312a6f5e1d5f.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Sous Chef) Compensation: 8,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are partnering with a highly regarded, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. 80488657ffe529a6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التفاعل الذكي للاتصالات عن فني شبكات تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الدعم الفني للموظفين والعملاء فيما يتعلق بمشاكل شبكات تقنية المعلومات، وتحديد المتطلبات اللازمة لحل المشكلات، وتوفير المعلومات الفنية الضرورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم والمساعدة الفنية للموظفين والعملاء الذين يواجهون مشاكل في شبكات تقنية المعلومات، والرد على استفساراتهم بهدف حل المشكلات التقنية. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات المطلوبة لأعمال دعم الموظفين والعملاء وحل المشاكل، ورفع النواقص إلى المعنيين لتأمينها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. توفير المعلومات الفنية المتعلقة بأجهزة ونظم وبرامج تقنية المعلومات، وإحالة المشكلات الكبيرة إلى أخصائيي تقنية المعلومات. حفظ وتبويب البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بكافة عمليات الدعم الفني المقدمة بالاستناد إلى الممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشخيص وحل مشاكل شبكات تقنية المعلومات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم الفني بفعالية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال الاتصالات وتقنية المعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

805342530af8b6a2.description: أخصائي جودة يساهم في تطبيق وتحسين نظام إدارة الجودة ودعم نظام الإدارة المتكامل داخل احد المنشآت الحكومية، من خلال تنظيم الوثائق والنماذج ومتابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات المعتمدة. يقوم بجمع مؤشرات الأداء المتعلقة بالجودة، والمشاركة في الزيارات الميدانية الداخلية والتجهيز لعمليات التدقيق الداخلي والخارجي وفق متطلبات الأيزو.

805fb45b21f1a6e7.description: نبذة عن الدور يتولى مسؤول المبيعات وخدمة العملاء في المركز العالمي لحماية التجارة الإلكترونية (WCPEC) بمدينة جدة، مسؤولية متابعة العملاء المحتملين والحاليين. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى التعريف بخدمات وبرامج المركز، والمساهمة في تحقيق أهدافه التجارية من خلال زيادة قاعدة العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التواصل الفعال مع الشركات والمؤسسات للتعريف بخدمات وبرامج المركز. متابعة العملاء المحتملين والحاليين لضمان استمرارية العلاقة وتطويرها. متابعة طلبات العملاء للاستفادة من الخدمات المقدمة. إعداد العروض التجارية المناسبة لاحتياجات العملاء. متابعة العملاء خلال مراحل التعاقد حتى إتمام الاتفاقيات. معالجة استفسارات العملاء وتقديم الدعم اللازم. توثيق بيانات العملاء ومتابعة فرص البيع المحتملة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في مدينة جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مسؤول المبيعات وخدمة العملاء ضمن فريق يدعم أهداف المركز في توسيع قاعدة عملائه. المزايا المالية يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في المركز العالمي لحماية التجارة الإلكترونية.

809bf26a0763a48f.company_name: شركة مركز الفداء المتميز للرعاية النهارية
809bf26a0763a48f.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز عبدالله سالم سعيد بادغيش لرعاية ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة في جازان عن مدير مركز رعاية اجتماعية للانضمام إلى فريقه. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق استراتيجية وأنشطة برامج ومؤسسات الرفاه الاجتماعي، والإشراف على الأخصائيين والمرشدين الاجتماعيين والمتطوعين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الاستراتيجية الشاملة لبرامج ومؤسسات الرفاه الاجتماعي، والإشراف على أنشطة تحديد الأسواق والمستخدمين النهائيين المستهدفين، ووضع خطط العمل المناسبة. إدارة العمليات اليومية، بما في ذلك منح المساعدات والإعانات والدعم، والإنقاذ في حالات الطوارئ والكوارث. وضع وتنسيق البرامج الهادفة إلى حماية الأطفال والنساء وكبار السن والفئات الخاصة الأخرى، والتخفيف من حالات المعاناة وعدم المساواة من خلال الحملات والبرامج المتخصصة. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم بما يتماشى مع الأهداف المحددة. وضع السياسات والإجراءات لضمان الامتثال لقوانين ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة الرعاية الاجتماعية أو الإشراف على البرامج الاجتماعية. فهم عميق لمبادئ الرفاه الاجتماعي وإدارة البرامج. القدرة على وضع الاستراتيجيات وتنفيذها بفعالية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على إدارة العمليات اليومية بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتوجيه. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتدريب الموظفين. معرفة بقوانين ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير مركز الرعاية الاجتماعية ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز عبدالله سالم سعيد بادغيش لرعاية ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة في مدينة جازان، في بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل الخدمات للفئات المستهدفة. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب غير معلن عنه. يرجى تقديم طلبك إذا كنت تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه.

(scenery, showcase, lighting, audiovisual equipment). - Management of the site supervision team and the contractors and sub-contractors. - Software, Code and Regulatory Expertise: Working working knowledge with local specifications.
